One repository for MCP for Unity and Launcher

New installations use the MCP for Unity Launcher VPM repository. It provides both packages.

Add to VCC/ALCOMD

Repository URL:
https://vrclearn.github.io/MCP-For-Unity-Launcher/index.json

Existing projects do not need to reinstall their packages. This old address remains a compatibility mirror for updates. After adding the new repository, you can remove the old repository from your package manager.

The MCP for Unity source repository, its Releases, and upstream synchronization continue here.
